judged_text: The migration string-interpolates the stored site-setting value h directly into a raw SQL INSERT: `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, category_id, ...) VALUES ('#{h}', ...)"`. Any admin-configured embeddable_hosts line containing a single quote (or anything that alters SQL syntax) breaks the migration mid-run or executes unintended SQL against the site_settings value; the migration's SELECT path treats this data as trusted and unescaped even though it is user-entered admin config, and this data-migration pattern invites copy-paste into future code that interpolates request-derived values.
